Forest Cycling Trail — excursion program

The Forest Cycling Trail accepts participants aged 12 and older with a minimum height of 145 cm.
Helmets and bicycles are included. The guided ride lasts 4 hours.
Customer cancellations are non-refundable; there is no free customer cancellation window.
If the operator cancels because of unsafe weather, the customer receives a full refund.
Departure is every Sunday at 08:30 from Forest Gate.
The price is EUR 45 per participant. Riders must already know how to cycle.

City Museum Visit — ticket information

The City Museum welcomes visitors of all ages. Children under 7 enter free.
Adult tickets cost EUR 15. Tickets for children aged 7 to 15 cost EUR 7.
The museum is wheelchair accessible and has lockers for bags. It is closed on Mondays.
Tickets can be cancelled for a full refund until 24 hours before the reserved entry time.
A typical visit takes 2 hours. On open days, entry is available between 09:00 and 17:00.
The permanent exhibition covers local history, maritime trade, and everyday life.

Aurora Hotel — family stay

Aurora Hotel offers free cancellation until 48 hours before arrival. Later cancellations cost the first night's room rate.
Children under 6 stay free when using existing beds. A family room accommodates up to 4 people.
Breakfast is included and served from 07:00 to 10:00.
An airport shuttle costs EUR 12 per person each way and must be booked one day in advance.
Two accessible rooms can be requested. The hotel has no swimming pool.
Check-in starts at 14:00; checkout is by 11:00.

Borealis Hotel — reservation conditions

All Borealis Hotel reservations are non-refundable. Cancelling a reservation does not return the room payment.
Guests must be at least 12 years old. Younger children cannot stay at this hotel.
The indoor swimming pool is open from 08:00 to 20:00.
Breakfast is not included in the room price and costs EUR 14 per person.
The airport shuttle is free for registered guests.
Check-in starts at 15:00; checkout is by 11:00.

Harbor Discovery Walk — excursion program

The Harbor Discovery Walk accepts children aged 4 and older. Strollers are allowed on the entire route.
The guided walk lasts 90 minutes. It departs daily at 10:00 from Pier 2.
Free cancellation is available until 24 hours before departure. Later cancellation is non-refundable.
The price is EUR 18 per adult and EUR 8 per child aged 4 to 12.
The walk includes the fish market, the old lighthouse, and the waterfront promenade.
The route is mostly flat but includes one short cobbled section.
